name: Quartermaster
tagline: A zero-sum household budget kept in Google Sheets, with a daily money report to read
description: It keeps a zero-sum budget, where every dollar of income is assigned a job, in a Google Sheet you own. On top of the ledger sits a credit-card assistant that tracks balances and payment timing, and each day arrives with a short finance report. An HTML dashboard makes the month readable at a glance.
author: yoshih543
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
